slides.tip: Use 'に' to indicate the recipient of a request.

grammar.title: Requesting with 'に' and '要請する'
bullets: Use 'に' to indicate the recipient of a request or action.
In Japan, technology companies often collaborate with the government on public safety initiatives.
You can use 'に要請する' when asking for assistance or features from a service provider.
